name: Ned2 compatibility
statement: The gripper solution shall be mechanically and functionally compatible with the Niryo Ned2.

name: EasyConnect interface
statement: Preferred solutions shall use or adapt to the EasyConnect tool interface.

name: Payload constraint
statement: Tool mass and object mass shall remain within the robot payload envelope.

name: Opening width
statement: Opening width shall match the target object geometry.

name: Object centering
statement: The gripper should provide repeatable object centering.

name: Fragile-object handling
statement: The contact concept should limit local pressure for fragile objects.

name: Irregular-object handling
statement: The solution should accommodate irregular geometries when required.

name: Internal gripping
statement: A solution alternative should support internal gripping of hollow parts.

name: Flat non-porous gripping
statement: Vacuum alternatives require flat, sufficiently non-porous surfaces.

name: Ferromagnetic gripping
statement: Magnetic alternatives require sufficient ferromagnetic contact.

name: Small-part precision
statement: The solution should allow accurate handling of small components.

name: Large-object opening
statement: The solution should provide increased opening for bulky objects.

name: Long reach
statement: A solution should reach recessed objects when needed.

name: Replaceable jaws
statement: Wear/contact parts should be independently replaceable.

name: Customizable contact geometry
statement: Contact geometry should be adaptable to workpiece geometry.

name: Sufficient contact friction
statement: Contact surfaces should provide sufficient friction without excessive damage.

name: Low end-effector mass
statement: End-effector mass should be minimized.

name: Design for disassembly
statement: Wear parts, structure and actuator should be separable where feasible.

name: Repairability
statement: High-wear components should be replaceable.

name: Low material diversity
statement: Avoid unnecessary material combinations.

name: Recyclable structural material
statement: Provide recyclable material alternatives where functional performance permits.

name: Local additive manufacturing
statement: Custom jaws should permit local/on-demand AM where suitable.

name: Reversible joining
statement: Prefer reversible fastening for replaceable contact parts.

name: Data traceability
statement: Assessment-relevant values shall retain source and quality metadata.
